title: Anthropic shares surge 34% in Nasdaq debut, valuation hits $2 trillion - The Economic Times
text:
Anthropic made a significant market debut on Nasdaq, with shares opening at $111.50, up from $83. The company raised a remarkable $81.3 billion through the sale of 980 million shares to investors. This listing positions Anthropic as a leader in the AI sector, following its establishment by OpenAI defectors. CEO Dario Amodei emphasized the company's commitment to promoting safe AI practices.
